html:
The incense stick craft village was formed over a thousand years ago, with the love for the profession and the skillful hands of the artisans of the Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, it has always preserved and developed as a symbol of the cultural beauty of the Vietnamese people. Although located in the suburbs of Hanoi, the incense stick craft village exudes the quintessence of beauty and is a check-in point, a virtual living place or to learn about the incense stick making process of the people here.

A few words about Quang Phu Cau incense village

Through the process of formation and development, the incense stick craft village of Quang Phu Cau commune, Ung Hoa district is about 30 km from the center of the capital. The development of the craft village not only brings income to the people here but is also a famous tourist destination in the suburbs of Hanoi.

Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village not only attracts tourists to visit and sightsee but also attracts photographers to come here to take pictures, especially foreign tourists who come to visit and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages.

How to get to Quang Phu Cau incense village?

Located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, visitors can easily choose a means of transportation to get here. From the center of the capital, visitors can take bus routes 103a, 91,99,94 to reach the incense village. If visitors like to sightsee, they can ride a motorbike….

What’s beautiful about Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Village

Currently, it is a quite famous check-in spot, especially recently when photos on the internet spread that Quang Phu Cau incense stick village looks very beautiful, with incense bundles spreading out like flowers or creative ideas to arrange incense bundles for visitors to take pictures, which looks very beautiful.

Traveling to Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Village, visitors will encounter incense bundles with the top of the incense stick and the bottom spread out, looking like blooming flowers. There are incense bundles dyed yellow and red, which look very eye-catching, so the incense village is increasingly attracting domestic and foreign tourists.

Incense production process

The incense bundles are carefully selected by artisans, from the stage of choosing raw materials to completion, to produce fragrant products, these are indispensable products in every home, and incense is currently exported to other countries.

To have beautiful photos at Quang Phu Cau incense village, visitors can rent traditional costumes to take beautiful photos of themselves in the incense village, especially women often choose dresses, or bring long clothes to take photos next to the incense bundles, which look very eye-catching.
